name: TranslateX for Loco Translate
author: edo888

sections.description:
This plugin connects the TranslateX automatic translator API, a powerful neural machine translation engine, directly into Loco Translate, allowing you to effortlessly translate your content with advanced automation.

External services

This plugin connects to TranslateX API to obtain translations.

It sends the original text strings you choose to translate every time there is a translation request from Loco Translate (e.g., you click Translate or run bulk translation).
The data is transmitted over a secure HTTPS connection to api.translatex.com and processed on TranslateX servers located in the United States and the European Union.

This service is provided by “GTranslate, Inc.”: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/translatex-for-loco-translate directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings → TranslateX for Loco Translate screen to configure the plugin and add your TranslateX API key
  4. Navigate to Loco Translate → Themes or Plugins → Choose the plugin/theme → Choose the language → Use bulk translation or suggest translation options
sections.faq:
Do I need to register to get a TranslateX API key?

Yes, registration is required. You can sign up on our website: translatex.com

Is it Free?

Yes, we have a Free plan for personal or non-commercial sites. For commercial projects or bigger needs, upgrade to a premium plan.

It doesn’t work, what to do?

Please check Translatex for Loco Translate Forum and feel free to create a new topic if you cannot find answers.

Which languages are supported?

We support the following languages: English, Arabic, Bulgarian, Bengali, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Finnish, French, Hindi, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, Lithuanian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
